title: Zesty Chewy Croatian Bun Bake
description: A sour, chewy Croatian-style bun bake with zesty lemon and basil, perfect for a dairy-free-friendly monsoon meal.
instructions: In a bowl mix flour, yeast, salt, and sugar until combined.
Add warm water and plant-based milk to the dry mixture and stir until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for eight minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise until doubled in size, about one hour.
Punch down the dough, roll it into a long rope, and divide into four equal buns.
Brush each bun with olive oil and sprinkle lemon zest, basil, and a pinch of salt.
Arrange buns on a parchment-lined baking sheet and bake at 200°C for fifteen minutes or until golden and chewy.
Remove from oven, let cool slightly, and serve warm.
